# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.1 — docs refresh

- Aligned the README with the new Typeform MCP docs at https://www.typeform.com/developers/mcp/.
- Documented OAuth with Client ID Metadata Documents (CIMD), PKCE, and `offline_access`.
- Documented the default and two EU endpoints, and which authorization server each uses.
- Expanded the capability table (themes, automations, contacts, insights), call order, scopes, and known gaps.
- Updated the plugin homepage to the new docs URL.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `typeform` MCP server pointing at `https://api.typeform.com/mcp`.
- Auth uses OAuth — no API key or client ID to configure.
- Logo: Typeform's official mark, from the `Typeform` GitHub organization.
